correctness.rationale: A general rank-two determinant identity for the inverse trace is derived from the Laplacian resolvent at its simple zero eigenvalue. Substitution of the exact K_{p,q} spectral projectors yields all four placement values; three difference identities are checked by symbolic simplification and independent rational matrix inversion. Positivity of the factored same-part difference and negativity of the reverse mixed orientation reduce optimization to two orbits. The remaining exact quadratic has negative linear and constant terms; the leading coefficient determines existence of the unique positive switching root, and explicit diagonal evaluation proves it exceeds the smaller gain. Integer size inequalities give the exact seven-vertex onset. No finite experiment is used to claim an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: An exactly motivated finite-actuator location problem is solved for an infinite graph family. The all-parameter switching rule, strict and exact tie structure, gain-imbalance cutoff, and unique smallest switching graph K_{2,5} provide concrete, reusable design information not furnished by generic optimization algorithms. Equal-gain placements cannot express the discovered relocation; scientific scope remains narrow and explicit.
